text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hmm… The weather forecast called for clear skies today, but perhaps I should purchase an umbrella before heading home.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Then again, I've heard Japanese weather reports are remarkably accurate.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I shall put my trust in it today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, the sky grows darker by the minute until…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Argh! This is horrible! It wasn't supposed to rain today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash's clothes and spirit are thoroughly drenched as the rain douses her.
